targetLabel: Dashboard — widget: פריטים עם תקלות חוזרות
actionLog: Implemented by a concurrent run as PR #72 (canonical, actionPrUrl below): turned the recurring-malfunctions widget's flat row list into a labeled table (header row + the already-computed-but-unshown stock-qty column from repairLeaderboard()). PR #76, a near-identical column-headers-only duplicate of #72 from another concurrent run, was closed. PR #77, a materially different concurrent implementation (adds a per-item expandable fault-history breakdown via an analytics.js change, not just headers), is still open at https://github.com/invierno8/commando/pull/77 — a human should decide whether to merge #77 on top of #72 (the two are complementary, not competing) or pick one.
